lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for most change types, as only eight categories have at least 2 tests.
Sign-in hints, sign-in reordering, finish new screens, and path choice hints were helpful, each yielding at least one winning test.
Adoption redesigns and home redesigns did not work, resulting in negative effects or no clear effect across multiple tests.
Path choice copy and home wait info changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, especially for redesigns.
Predictions were significantly too low for unexpected wins like sign-in reordering and path choice hints.

candidates.title: Path Selection Multi-Choice Preview Hint
candidates.change: Displays a helpful tip banner explaining how path options customize pet traits and desktop behaviors right under the path choices.
candidates.why: Dropoff at choose_path is 22.2% with a long mean duration (514s); path choice hints previously yielded successful test results.

choose_path.hint: Select custom generation or template adoption to tailor your pet's personality and appearance.

guard.reason: Adds a valid helpful hint to choose_path within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Path choice hints are proven winners (+1.7% lift, 2 tests) and very low cost.

candidates.title: Pet Desktop Behavior Setup Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new interactive setup screen after home_intro where users configure screen docking preferences and hotkey controls before completing setup.
candidates.why: Support received 3 separate emails complaining of confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after onboarding.

new_pet_controls_setup.headline: Configure Desktop Controls
new_pet_controls_setup.body: Set up hotkeys and preferred screen side for your pet.

guard.reason: Adds a new setup screen after home_intro, which is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from dropoff and 3 support emails, but creating new screens has zero cost efficiency and modest historical lift (+0.4%).

candidates.title: Sign In Post Waiting Stage Reorder
candidates.change: Moves the sign_in screen after the waiting stage, allowing users to experience pet rendering before asking for account authentication.
candidates.why: Sign-in reordering was identified as an effective mechanism, and asking for sign-in after user investment reduces dropoff.

guard.reason: Reorders sign_in to after waiting stage, which is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering is a proven win (+1.7% lift across 2 tests) by increasing user investment.

candidates.title: Sign In Existing Pet Account Notice
candidates.change: Adds a clear hint on the sign_in screen reminding returning users to sign in with their original account method to retain existing pets.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again, indicating account confusion during login.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with the exact account used previously to automatically restore your saved pet.

guard.reason: Adds helpful account guidance on sign_in screen without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence (top theme with 8 support emails); hints are reliable winners (+0.4% across 4 tests) and config-only.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Trait Sound Selection Flow
candidates.change: Embeds dynamic audio sample components into the pet selection screen so users can listen to pet sound effects while choosing.
candidates.why: Adoption has the largest single dropoff rate (30.2%) with median time 89s; interactive feedback enhances motivation during adoption.

guard.reason: Embeds audio previews in pet selection stage without removing key functionality.

candidates.score_note: Target step has highest dropoff (30.2%), but adoption redesigns/new flows historically failed (-2.5% to -3.4%) and cost is high.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Activity Progress Tips
candidates.change: Adds a tip carousel to the waiting screen displaying key desktop control tips while pet assets render in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting stage on home has high mean duration (2336s), and users frequently ask how to interact with pets after setup.

components.text: Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon your pet to the mouse cursor.

guard.reason: Adds waiting screen progress tips as allowed by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Home wait info changes consistently showed negative/no effect (-1.4% across 2 tests).

candidates.title: Home Intro Quick Desktop Command Bar
candidates.change: Switches home_intro to a compact layout with an integrated checklist showing keyboard shortcuts for hiding and talking to the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Finish step dropoff is 26.9%, and multiple support tickets reflect confusion over basic desktop pet controls.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro layout with command shortcuts without removing required jobs.

candidates.score_note: Finish step dropoff is high (26.9%) with support backing; finish layout changes previously yielded +3.0%.

candidates.title: Story Welcome Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the story welcome screen into a stage layout featuring an animated mascot character component to introduce the experience.
candidates.why: Story screen dropoff affects choose_path funnel (22.2% dropoff); an engaging initial visual mascot sets strong app tone.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Adoption Photo Failure Guidance Info
candidates.change: Adds explicit quality and format requirements to the photo upload screen to prevent custom pet generation failures.
candidates.why: Support received 3 complaints about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong during adoption.

upload_photos.hint: Use clear, well-lit photos (JPG/PNG). If generation fails, template presets can be selected.

guard.reason: Adds clear photo quality guidance to upload_photos screen.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has highest dropoff; photo guidance hint addresses support issues at minimal implementation cost.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen System Readiness Notification
candidates.change: Enables desktop notifications on the waiting screen to alert users when their desktop pet finished loading while the window was backgrounded.
candidates.why: Home wait time has a very high mean (2336s), leading users to minimize the app and suffer dropoffs or launch confusion.

guard.reason: Enables readiness notifications on waiting screen as allowed by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications previously resulted in a -2.5% lift loss.

picked: Sign In Post Waiting Stage Reorder
Interactive Pet Trait Sound Selection Flow
Home Intro Quick Desktop Command Bar
